briefing.what: The median consultation wait time is currently 116 minutes, which is 26.1% above the baseline of 92 minutes. This elevation is based on a sample of 2046 consult records.
briefing.where: The delay is attributed to the Physiotherapy Clinic, which has a median wait time of 213 minutes. Data confidence is limited because only 39.0% of visits have complete timestamp coverage.
briefing.when: The peak day is Wednesday, with the highest average wait occurring at 11:00. The concentration window for elevated demand spans the hours of 09:00 to 11:00.
briefing.mechanism: Volume is the supported mechanism, as peak arrivals are 1.65 times the overall average during the 09:00 to 11:00 window. Capacity and scheduling mechanisms are not applicable due to missing staffing and appointment data.
briefing.downstream: Incomplete care is supported, with a cohort rate of 4.7% compared to the 3.5% baseline. Pharmacy impact is not applicable because this patient pathway does not include pharmacy visits.
briefing.unknowns: Missing staffing data would clarify if provider availability limits throughput during peak hours. Missing appointment data would determine if session scheduling contributes to the wait time concentration.
briefing.action: The Physiotherapy Clinic Manager should investigate the demand pattern and its operational cause during the 09:00 to 11:00 window.
